title: DeLonge's NRO sources on predicting episodic craft visits

tellings.quote: he says that his highlevel sources in the NRO specifically told him that scientists and eggghheads had figured out ways to basically pre-predict when and where craft would appear

plain: The musician Tom DeLonge has said that high-level sources in the NRO, the US agency that runs spy satellites, told him government scientists had worked out ways to predict when and where unknown craft would appear. The online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb retells this as something DeLonge said, apparently on the podcast of the host Joe Rogan, around 2017. If true, it would mean the government can anticipate these visits rather than just react to them.
